categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Faith Long Crystal Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of piezoelectric quartz crystal components, including SMD resonators, TSX thermosensitive crystals, TCXO oscillators, and OSC oscillators. These products serve as essential frequency control and selection components widely used in electronics, communications, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, IoT, aerospace, and security products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor-based photolithography technology for producing high-frequency, miniaturized quartz crystal wafers, surpassing traditional mechanical grinding methods. It also employs multilayer and multi-metal sputtering coating, high-precision glue dispensing, ion etching frequency tuning, and high-frequency continuous pulse welding technologies. The company has developed mass production capabilities for high-value-added products like TCXO oscillators and TSX thermosensitive crystals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international smartphone manufacturers, smart home appliance companies, IoT module manufacturers, and IC design firms specializing in Beidou navigation and automotive electronics. The products are used extensively in mobile terminals, automotive electronics, wearable devices, smart homes, industrial control, and aerospace sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Dongguan, Guangdong Province. It also has subsidiaries in Chongqing, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and plans for expansion in South Korea. Overseas sales account for approximately 12.67% of total revenue, with growing presence in Japan, South Korea, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Faith Long Crystal operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of quartz crystal components and oscillators. It sources raw materials and key components such as ceramic bases and IC chips, some of which have been domestically substituted through joint development with suppliers. The company supplies these components to downstream electronics manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in miniaturization, high-frequency, and high-precision quartz crystal components, including high-frequency TCXO and TSX products. It invests in semiconductor photolithography processes and temperature compensation algorithms. Strategic R&D projects target automotive-grade TCXO, AI server and optical communication oscillators, and small-sized 1610 tuning fork crystals. The company also focuses on digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of quartz crystal components and oscillators, including SMD resonators, TCXO oscillators, TSX thermosensitive crystals, and system integration products. The company employs both direct sales and distribution channels, with a growing emphasis on direct sales to major customers. Software and information technology services contribute a smaller portion of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Faith Long Crystal is one of the leading domestic manufacturers of MHz piezoelectric quartz crystal components in China, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' and Guangdong provincial manufacturing champion. The industry is competitive with major global players from Japan, the USA, Taiwan, and China. The company holds a leading position domestically in small-size, high-frequency, and temperature-compensated crystal products and is the only mainland Chinese company listed in MediaTek and Qualcomm reference design platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 551 million, a 38.33% increase from the previous year, but a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 189 million, reflecting a 12.22% decline. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.67 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 635 million. Despite losses, the company is growing its revenue and expanding production capacity, with increased R&D investment and product shipments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Faith Long Crystal emphasizes its advanced semiconductor photolithography technology enabling high-frequency, miniaturized quartz crystal components with superior precision and stability. Its products offer high reliability, low power consumption, and excellent temperature compensation, meeting stringent automotive and communication standards. The company’s early market entry, platform certifications from major IC design firms, and strong customer relationships provide competitive advantages in domestic substitution and global market penetration.
